import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
# residualize tensile on lab, then correlate with each candidate
Xl = sm.add_constant(pd.get_dummies(d['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float))
res = sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'], Xl).fit().resid
print("Residual (lab-adjusted) correlations:")
for c in cands:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[c])
    r = np.corrcoef(dd[c], res.loc[dd.index])[0,1]
    print(f"{c:14s} r={r:7.4f}")
print()
# check outliers in tensile
print("tensile quantiles:", np.percentile(d['tensile_mpa'],[0,1,5,50,95,99,100]).round(2))
# robust regression (Huber) for each
for c in cands:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[c]).copy()
    Xl2 = pd.get_dummies(dd['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X = pd.concat([dd[[c]].astype(float), Xl2], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.RLM(dd['tensile_mpa'], X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()
    print(f"{c:14s} RLM coef={m.params[c]:8.4f} t={m.tvalues[c]:7.3f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}")

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']

    Xl2=pd.get_dummies(dd['lab'],drop_first=True).astype(float)
    spl=dmatrix(f"cr({c}, df=4)", dd, return_type='dataframe')
    X=pd.concat([spl,Xl2],axis=1)

    m=sm.OLS(dd['tensile_mpa'],X).fit()
